title: Ideas and Goal Lists to Pick From

items.title: Weight × Reps History for Each Exercise
items.why: Opens from the exercise in the Library. Each session counts its heaviest set; the estimate uses the Epley formula (weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30)), named on screen. Goku never asks anyone to test a real one-rep max. Pictures use made-up numbers.

options.label: A small chart plus the last 3 sessions
options.desc: A line of the estimate over time, then the sets it came from.

options.label: A list only, no chart
options.desc: Every session as a row: date, weight × reps, estimate.

items.title: Faster Week-Hours Entry
items.why: Today each day takes up to 16 taps of 15 minutes. Both choices keep − and + for fine steps.

options.label: Tap a number of hours
options.desc: 0, 1, 1½, 2, 2½, 3 or 4 h in one tap.

options.label: Type the hours, with “Same hours on Mon to Fri”
options.desc: A number box and one button to copy the day to weekdays.

items.title: Pace for Running, Cycling, Rowing and Swimming
items.why: Worked out from minutes and distance; nothing new to type. Runs and rows show time per mile, km or 500 m; rides show mph or km/h; swims show time per 100 yd or m.

options.label: Show pace as you type
options.desc: Under the distance box, before you save.

options.label: Show pace on your history only
options.desc: After saving, next to each activity.

items.title: Repeat Yesterday’s Food in One Tap
items.why: Shown only when the meal or day is still empty, so it never adds twice by accident.

options.label: One meal at a time
options.desc: Add food shows “Same breakfast as yesterday” at the top for the meal you picked.

options.label: The whole day at once
options.desc: “Copy all of yesterday” on an empty Nutrition page.

items.title: Start the Last Workout Again
items.why: Split from “Repeat yesterday” so you can pick each one. Today Goku builds a fresh circuit from your Library each day.

options.label: A “Same as last time” button under Enter the chamber
options.desc: Same moves and order as your last session; the ghost races it.

items.title: Rest Time for Each Exercise, and Supersets
items.why: Both are set in the exercise’s Edit screen. The workout screen stays the same.

options.label: Rest per exercise only
options.desc: Circuit default, 60 s, 90 s or 2 min after this move.

options.label: Rest per exercise and supersets
options.desc: Also “Pair with the next exercise”: two moves back to back, then the rest.

items.title: How Custom Goal Ideas Work
items.why: The next screens list ideas for each sport, one sport per screen. A Custom profile sees the ideas for the sports it picked, plus the current strength list (5 pull-ups, squat my bodyweight…) if it picked Strength, and the gymnastics list if it picked Gymnastics. Ideas are only suggestions to tap; anyone can type their own. None are about weight or body size.

options.label: Change how it works
options.desc: Type what you want in the note.

items.title: Goal Ideas for Running
items.why:
Ideas shown to a Custom profile that picked Running:
• Run 5 km (3.1 mi) without stopping
• Run 30 minutes without stopping
• Run 3 times a week for 4 weeks
• Take a minute off my 5 km time

options.label: Use them with my changes
options.desc: Type changes in the note: add, remove or reword.
